text_block_list.name: Elementary School Teacher
text_block_list.text: "Shakur is a very bright child. However, she has a hard time understanding that being correct doesn't always mean she's right..."

text_block_list.name: Elementary School Teacher
text_block_list.text:
"To be completely honest, the other
teachers and I aren't sure how to
deal with
her. She's completely isolated herself
from her class. She's even gotten in a few
fights."

text_block_list.name: Elementary School Teacher
text_block_list.text:
"I swear, we're all doing our best to
understand her, but... unless she starts
putting in a little effort to reciprocate,
there's not much more
we can do..."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"I'm sorry,
but she's always been like that.
It's just who she is... You don't have to
worry about her.
You'll only provoke her..."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: (Ever since I was a kid, I've always been some sort of enigma to others. No matter what I did, it was wrong because I'm wrong.)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(Whenever people spoke, all I'd hear was
noise... We'd be speaking the same
language, but no one understood what I
was saying. Eventually, I gave up and shut
up.)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(That's when I discovered computers. It
felt like I was hearing someone speak for
the first time. Turns out programming
languages
were the only ones I needed.)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(With a partner like that,
I could make all the noise disappear.
Around that time is
when I found the most effective way to
prove myself—as a student at Tracen
Academy.)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I finished Parcae shortly after enrolling,
and they were the perfect partner. The
more data I entered, the more accurate
the answer they
gave.)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"Just what is Air Shakur thinking... She
doesn't listen to the teachers,
is generally
uncooperative, and can be self-absorbed...
But..."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"I don't want to run with Shakur at all...
It's
like she's from another
planet sometimes...
It's scary. But..."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: "She's winning, so she's clearly skilled."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(...That was the best part. When I won a
race, everyone would shut their mouths,
getting rid of the noise. So I decided to
aim even
higher.)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(If I won more, or better races... Yeah,
if I earned a title only the best
of the best
receive... If I could become the Triple
Crown champion...)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(Then
maybe,
they'd
■■■■■■■■■■ ■■. Or so I thought...)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After following Air Shakur from her
practice, I find her standing in the

courtyard.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: It's... you again. What do you want?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Huh? Ah... Huh?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Hmph... The hell? Where'd that come
from...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Wait, is that all you came here to say? If
so, good for you. Now hurry
up and get
lost.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Of course that's not the only thing. I want to see her run more—get to know her more. I...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...What?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I suppose it seemed rather sudden, but the
moment I said it, I knew it
was true. I've
wanted to be her trainer from the moment
we met.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...I don't see the logic in this. Ahh,
did you fall for my run or
something? Then too bad, I refuse.
I don't have time for baseless 
proposals.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
What good would that information do? If
you really want to be my
trainer, write up
a proposal based on my skills or a goal.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
How? What could you possibly... What
makes you think you'd do a
better job
than me?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Nutrition, sports engineering... I've memorized countless essays and data sets. So tell me— how exactly are you gonna help me?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: You don't have an answer, do you? Spit it out. Truth is... you just want to be my trainer.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: You want to be helpful. You want to be my savior. But truth is you can't do anything.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She throws her rejection in my face... but
behind those harsh words
hides the
information I want. I'm not backing down
now.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Oh, for crying out loud. Would you just—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...You know what? Follow me. I'll let the
numbers do the talking.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: This is the answer Parcae lead me to.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Before us lies Air Shakur's precious
laptop.
On the screen, I see she's
opened up a
program of some sort.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There I see countless equations and
variables—enough to fill the
whole screen.
And at the very end, after the equals sign
is...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
That's the answer I got the first time I
calculated everything, and it
hasn't
changed since. By this calculation...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I will lose the Japanese Derby by seven
centimeters, and with it, I'll
lose my shot at
the Triple Crown. End of story.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Triple Crown refers to three G1 races
runners can only tackle in their classic
year: the Satsuki Sho, the Japanese Derby,
and the
Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Racers who win all three are known as
Triple Crown champions. Among thousands
of challengers, only a select few have
manage to
snag that title.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I... will never be a Triple Crown
champion.
No matter how many times
I run the inputs,
the answer is always the same.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
And don't try to suggest that the
program's off. Trust me, it's not. I
can
guarantee that... which means my loss is
also... guaranteed.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Do you get it now? Nothing you do can
help me. If I can't fix this... no
one can.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I can't truly understand how hopeless her struggle seems, but I can tell that she's still fighting despite that. And there can only be one reason as to why...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This is what I wanted to know—her dream.
It may not come off as
special—heck,
everyone has a dream—but as long as she
has that...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
If dreams alone could change anything,
don't you think that would've
happened
already?!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: I know it's futile, pathetic even... But I've redone all the calculations again and again and again and again and AGAIN! Nothing changed!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
But I run and run... and run more! Just
hoping... someday... But it... it
was all
useless... And then you have the nerve...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: To just show up and act like you can change things! So go ahead... tell me how it'll be different with you!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur lashes out in anger and
despair. Undoubtedly, her own
training is what
lead her to this conclusion,
and I won't sit here telling
her she's wrong... but...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Anyway, I think you get the point. And
even if you don't, just leave
me alone.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She may have rejected my offer this time,
but for some reason, I don't
feel like giving
up just yet.
